name: Jadav Form Lead Qualification
author: Jadav Sanjay

sections.description:
Jadav Form Lead Qualification is a lightweight form builder for creating responsive forms and managing submissions inside WordPress.

Key features:

  • Admin form builder with text, email, phone, number, textarea, dropdown, radio, checkbox, date, time, URL, file upload, and page break fields.
  • Multi-step frontend forms with progress indicators.
  • Shortcode embedding with [jadav_form_lead_qualification id="123"].
  • Saved entries with admin detail view, read/unread state, search, and CSV export.
  • Email notifications for every submission.
  • Honeypot and one-minute per-IP rate limiting.
  • Optional login requirement, open/close scheduling, and entry limits.
  • Automatic UTM/referrer capture and local lead scoring so entries are grouped as cold, warm, or hot without sending data to an external service.

Why it is different:

Jadav Form Lead Qualification focuses on first-party lead qualification. It stores campaign attribution with each entry and calculates a local lead score from submitted intent signals, logged-in user context, uploaded files, and UTM data. The scoring runs on the site and does not call an external API.

Privacy

Submissions are stored in your WordPress database. If enabled per form, IP address, user agent, UTM values, and referrer URL are stored with the entry. The lead score is calculated locally on your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload jadav-form-lead-qualification to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress admin.
  3. Go to Jadav Lead Qualification -> Add New.
  4. Copy the shortcode into any page, post, or widget area.
sections.faq:
Does Jadav Form Lead Qualification include a trial, paywall, or pro-only feature gate?

No. The features included in this plugin are available without license checks, subscriptions, artificial usage cutoffs, or paid unlocks.

Does Jadav Form Lead Qualification download executable code from external services?

No. The plugin does not load remote PHP, JavaScript modules, or executable code from third-party services.

Does Jadav Form Lead Qualification allow arbitrary PHP or JavaScript execution?

No. The form builder creates form fields and stores submissions. It does not provide a PHP, JavaScript, HTML, or file editor for executing arbitrary code on the site.
